activity_summary: At home you put the line in both places, Burby's entered book and your coffer, and you did not open the folder. You set this December entry next to the True Tragedy in May. Then you went to eat before Navarre.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the proof, and kept the folder shut.

facets.activity: Said the line was in Burby's book and in the coffer

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The line's in Burby's book and in my coffer. Which of us has it?

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: He has paper from the Hall. I have only the making.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The True Tragedy in May, this in December. I am being published by everybody but myself.
